analysis:
The 2009 manifesto committed the party to a National Food Security Act modelled on the legal-guarantee approach of NREGA, and specified an entitlement of 25 kg of rice or wheat per BPL family per month at Rs 3/kg. The manifesto frame for comparison was the earlier PDS norm of 35 kg per family at higher prices.

The Act was promulgated as an Ordinance on 5 July 2013 and passed by both Houses in August-September 2013, receiving assent on 10 September 2013. Its structure differs in form from the manifesto wording: entitlement is defined per person (5 kg per person per month for priority households) and AAY households get 35 kg per household per month, with prices capped at Rs 3/2/1 per kg for rice, wheat and coarse grains. A family of five at 5 kg per person equals the 25 kg per family figure in the manifesto.

Coverage is up to 75 per cent of the rural and 50 per cent of the urban population, i.e. about two-thirds of the population once identified. Rollout across states was gradual, and the Act was passed roughly four years into the 2009-2014 term.
notes: The quote is the printed manifesto text, released under Sonia Gandhi as Congress President; quote_is_verbatim=true refers to the manifesto document rather than a spoken transcript. The manifesto frame of reference (35 kg per family at higher prices under the older PDS) was also raised by opposition parties at the time.
